record.question: Under which Article that the Fundamental Rights can be amend?
record.explanation: The constitutional provision for amending Fundamental Rights is Article 368 (constituent amending power), which is not among the options. Article 359 deals with suspension during Emergency, Article 371 with special State provisions, Article 350 with language, and Article 370 with former J&K provisions — none governs amendment of Fundamental Rights. The question appears defective; no defensible option can be chosen.
